python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
import music21, converter21
converter21.register()
root=Path('inputs/inputs')
ids=__import__('json').loads((root/'samples.json').read_text())
canvas=Image.new('RGB',(2100, sum(340 for _ in ids)), 'white')
draw=ImageDraw.Draw(canvas)
for i,s in enumerate(ids):
 im=Image.open(root/'images'/f'{s}.png').convert('RGB'); im.thumbnail((2050,290)); im=im.resize((im.width*2,im.height*2)) if im.width<1050 else im
 canvas.paste(im,(10,i*340+35)); draw.text((10,i*340+10),s,fill='black')
canvas.save('source-sheet.png')
for s in ids:
 p=root/'baselines/audiveris-enlarged'/f'{s}-raw.mxl'
 try:
  score=music21.converter.parse(p)
  out=score.write('humdrum',fp=f'probe-{s}.krn')
  parsed=music21.converter.parse(out)
  print(s,'raw conversion OK',len(parsed.flatten().notes), 'duration',parsed.duration.quarterLength)
 except Exception as e: print(s,'raw conversion FAILED',type(e).__name__,str(e)[:400])
for label in ['C:maj','C major','D:min/C','D minor/C']:
 try:
  sc=music21.converter.parseData('**kern\t**mxhm\n4c\t'+label+'\n*-\t*-\n',format='humdrum')
  print('HARMONY',label,[(type(x).__name__,str(x)) for x in sc.flatten() if isinstance(x,music21.harmony.ChordSymbol)])
 except Exception as e: print('HARMONY FAIL',label,str(e)[:200])
